say:0:1711171001:1.text: His scheme has been exposed. The high-tier arcane backlash was a lie, and there's no body in that specially sealed coffin.
say:0:1711171001:1.source_cn: 现在，克拉夫特的计划已经被彻底揭穿——高阶以太分解反应...

say:1:1711171002:1.text: Kraff faked his own death, and that pristine grave may very well be the key to finding him.
say:1:1711171002:1.source_cn: 克拉夫特伪造了自己的死亡，而那个一尘不染的墓地，极有可...
